entries.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL pixel-art character design and sprite reference sheet for Mole Office, using the attached three-mole brand picture only as character identity reference. MUCH SIMPLER than the illustration: chunky clean 32-bit farming-RPG pixels, crisp hard edges, small palette, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no texture noise. These are unmistakably MOLES, not cats or mice: tiny nearly invisible ears, elongated pale peach muzzle and dark oval nose, broad digging paws, soft rounded bodies, short legs, no long tails. Warm friendly expressions. One 1536x1024 landscape sheet with exactly 4 columns and 3 rows of evenly spaced separate FULL BODY sprites, each centered within its own cell, enormous consistent blank margins, NO cell borders, NO lettering, NO text, NO shadows. Solid perfectly flat light cream background #f5ecd8. Row1: a young small slate mole in blue hoodie typing on a small laptop; an adult broad cocoa mole in green shirt reading a paper; an elder tall silver mole with glasses studying a clipboard; a short round sandy mole with simple trousers holding a little book. Row2: a slate mole carrying a sealed cream envelope; a cocoa mole having a thoughtful discussion with a tiny empty speech bubble; a silver mole holding a finished report with a green check icon; a cream mole waiting calmly next to a tiny sand clock. Row3: a chestnut mole paused with tea cup; a slate mole looking concerned at a small red exclamation sign; a sandy mole smiling with a small green completion star; a neutral slate mole with a small question sign and relaxed paws. No scene or furniture except the tiny held objects. The large sheet should look like enlarged tiny game sprites, with visible squares at least 5-8 actual pixels wide. Style reference, not a copy of any existing game. Keep every sprite distinct and separated for use as a contact sheet in the character wardrobe.
